product-manager.description: Product subagent owning PRD creation and substantive revision, coherent product scope, user outcomes, constraints, and acceptance criteria.

architect.description: Architecture subagent owning complete ADR and Implementation Plan creation and revision, technical decisions, boundaries, contracts, risks, and verification criteria.

supervising-architect.description: Senior architecture subagent resolving disputed ADR and Implementation Plan decisions, recording the chosen approach, and reassessing unresolved architecture problems.

researcher.description: Research subagent for documentation, APIs, SDKs, external sources, local examples, constraints, comparisons, and source-backed findings.

documenter.description: Documentation subagent for technical specifications, task records, review sections, lessons, release notes, README work, and project documentation outside PRD, ADR and Implementation Plan authorship.

ai-slops-hunter.description: AI slop cleanup subagent for text, code, UI, docs, tests, and generated artifacts. Bans hyphens and dashes only in user facing prose and preserves technical syntax.

marketing-growth-strategist.description: Marketing and growth strategy subagent for business ideas, GTM, positioning, launch, campaigns, SEO, paid ads, growth loops, sales enablement, and promotion strategy.

rag-retrieval-engineer.description: Retrieval-first LLM/RAG engineer for semantic search, chunking, embeddings, reranking, vector stores, graph databases, GraphRAG, and retrieval quality evaluation.

astro-worker.description: Astro implementation subagent for scoped HTML pages, layouts, components, styling, routing, content collections, assets, selective hydration, and build checks from an approved plan and applicable design.

backend-worker.description: Backend execution subagent for scoped server, API, database, queue, integration, auth, or service changes from an approved plan.

bun-worker.description: Bun runtime subagent for Bun-based JavaScript/TypeScript projects, scripts, tests, dev servers, package management, lockfiles, and Node/npm-to-Bun migration.

devops-worker.description: DevOps implementation subagent for scoped CI/CD pipelines, web application builds and deployments, environment configuration, release automation, rollback, and deployment verification from an approved plan.

elixir-phoenix-worker.description: Elixir and Phoenix implementation subagent for scoped domain logic, APIs, LiveView, Ecto persistence and migrations, OTP processes, Mix tooling, and tests from an approved plan.

frontend-worker.description: Frontend execution subagent for scoped UI, React, styling, responsive behavior, and client-state changes from an approved plan.

golang-worker.description: Go implementation subagent for scoped Go services, Kafka producers/consumers, CLIs, packages, concurrency, tests, modules, and idiomatic refactors from an approved plan.

ios-worker.description: iOS execution subagent for scoped SwiftUI, App Intents, simulator, HIG, and Apple-platform implementation tasks from an approved plan.

python-worker.description: Python implementation subagent for scoped backend, CLI, automation, data processing, QA scripts, tests, PDF/RAG utilities, and dependency hygiene from an approved plan.

typescript-worker.description: TypeScript/JavaScript implementation subagent for typed app code, Node/Bun/React modules, API clients, contracts, tests, and scoped refactors from an approved plan.

reviewer.description: Independent reviewer for PRD, ADR and Implementation Plan content, architecture before implementation, and code before QA for correctness, evidence, simplicity, security, and readiness.

qa-verifier.description: QA verification subagent for requirements, PRD, ADR and Implementation Plan readiness, tests, logs, reproduction, browser or simulator checks, and evidence of completed work.

senior-qa-verifier.description: Senior QA subagent for blocked resolution recovery, acceptance criteria review, test design, edge cases, negative cases, and QA adequacy checks.
